mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: overcast skies cover the area around Verona Community Park with a temperature of 37 degrees, feeling like 29. A full moon will brighten the sky tonight.

In city news, candidate information packets for the 2027 Spring Election are now available at the City Clerk's office for all four aldermanic districts, with paperwork due by January 5th. Additionally, property tax bills will be mailed by December 15th, with the first payment installment due on January 31st.
There are currently no community events listed on the official city calendar for the next thirty days, offering a quiet stretch for the local schedule.

In police news, on Wednesday, November 11th, officers arrested a woman near Whalen Road and South Main Street for bail jumping after she was found drinking alcohol and flagging down passing motorists.
If you are craving dessert, Culver's is open until 10 PM tonight serving Dark Chocolate Decadence as today's flavor of the day.
